response.justification: Bogdan brings solid staff-level engineering credentials and is currently working on AI-agent infrastructure and MCP at re:cinq, demonstrating active engagement with key technologies. However, his track record lacks the 8+ years of production AI/ML systems development explicitly required for this role, and Python—listed as a primary language requirement—is absent from his skill set. His AI-specific experience appears limited to the past 16 months, making it difficult to assess depth in GenAI systems. Strong fundamentals and current trajectory warrant conversation, but significant domain expertise gaps exist.
strengths: Currently building AI-agent infrastructure and MCP code generators at re:cinq, with direct experience in agentic workflows and relevant production systems
Staff-level engineer with 17+ years of software engineering experience, including distributed systems handling millions of requests/second and proven mentorship/knowledge-sharing track record
Strong TypeScript and AWS cloud platform expertise with demonstrated ability to ship scalable production systems across multiple domains
concerns: Python—explicitly required as a primary development language alongside TypeScript—is notably absent from skill set; background is heavily TypeScript/Node.js focused
Lacks demonstrated 8+ years in production AI/ML/GenAI systems; AI-specific experience limited to recent role at re:cinq (approximately 16 months) with unclear depth in core technologies
No explicit experience with vector databases, RAG architectures, or LLM performance optimization—all core technical requirements for the role

key_factors.factor: Current AI-agent infrastructure role with MCP experience
Missing Python expertise and insufficient AI/ML domain background
Strong staff-level engineering foundations and mentorship capabilities
